neet_phy_u08_t01_1.working: Internal energy depends only on the state of the gas. Heat, work and the area under the P-V curve all depend on the path taken.

neet_phy_u08_t01_2.working: Work done = area under the linear P-V line = average pressure × change in volume = (2×10^5 Pa)(2×10^-3 m^3) = 400 J.

neet_phy_u08_t01_3.working: ΔU = n Cv ΔT for any process. For a diatomic gas Cv = (5/2)R, so ΔU = 2 × 2.5 × 8.3 × 10 = 415 J.

neet_phy_u08_t01_4.working: Expansion gives positive work (A-IV). Compression gives negative work (B-II). Constant volume gives zero work (C-I). A clockwise cycle gives positive net work equal to the enclosed area (D-III).

neet_phy_u08_t01_5.working: A, B and D are true. C is false because an anticlockwise cycle gives negative net work. E is false because ΔU is path-independent.
